sourceFile: 72. TIU C11-20  Report Test Frame damage mesh 2026.03.28. - RAW soundcheck_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable evidence but the changed-factor and baseline grouping are not reliable.
issues: Changed factor wrongly mixes shift, model, and test type.
L-side tests use the R-side Normal baseline.
R and L model/type groups are not preserved.
SPL/THD measurement stats include header artifacts and are not judged.
Review title is taken from raw data instead of the report context.
correctionPlan: Redefine factor as Frame Test Type versus Normal within TIU C11-20R and TIU C11-20L groups.
Compare Type 1 and Type 3 to R Normal; compare Type 2 and Type 4 to L Normal.
Keep date and shift as context, not changed conditions.
Summarize function NG outcomes from Test rows, including Type 4 failure and Normal L noise result.
Either rebuild SPL/THD outcomes from valid graph/raw tables or omit them as unverified.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but semantic citations are insufficient until regrouped.
